quickglance.midnightconfig.title: QuickGlance Settings
quickglance.midnightconfig.animDurationM: The speed at which the tooltip appears and disappears.
quickglance.midnightconfig.gracePeriodMs:
The time the interface waits before closing.
Useful for preventing flickering when shifting your gaze between stoves.
